properties.description: Full refresh ingestion pipeline from ADLS Gen2 to ADLS Gen2. Reads all active Full Refresh Ingress jobs for the given trigger from EDP_Metadata.MasterRef. Switch routes each job to the correct Copy activity based on the source and target file format combination (CSV, Parquet, JSON). All 9 format-to-format combinations are covered. Parallel processing via ForEach (batchCount=5).

activities.name: Lookup_Metadata
activities.description: Fetches all active Full Refresh Ingress jobs for the given TriggerName from EDP_Metadata.MasterRef.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT * FROM EDP_Metadata.MasterRef WHERE Trigger_Name = ''', pipeline().parameters.TriggerName, ''' AND IsActive = ''Active'' AND Load_Type = ''Full_Refresh'' AND ActivityType = ''Ingress''')

activities.name: ForEach_Jobs
activities.description: Iterates over all active jobs returned by the metadata lookup and processes them in parallel (batchCount=5).

activities.name: Switch_OutputFormat
activities.description: Routes each job to the correct Copy activity based on SwitchCaseRef (source LS + source format + output LS + output format). Covers all 9 combinations: CSV/Parquet/JSON as source and CSV/Parquet/JSON as target.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_CSV_to_ADLS_CSV
activities.description: Full refresh: copies CSV from source ADLS path to target ADLS path as CSV. All connection and path details resolved from metadata at runtime.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_CSV_to_ADLS_PARQUET
activities.description: Full refresh: converts CSV to Parquet (Snappy compressed). ADF infers column types from the CSV header row.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_CSV_to_ADLS_JSON
activities.description: Full refresh: converts CSV to JSON. Each CSV row becomes a JSON object keyed by column headers.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_PARQUET_to_ADLS_CSV
activities.description: Full refresh: converts Parquet to CSV. Column delimiter resolved from OutputColDelimitter in metadata.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_PARQUET_to_ADLS_PARQUET
activities.description: Full refresh: copies Parquet to Parquet (Snappy compressed). Source and target can be different storage accounts.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_PARQUET_to_ADLS_JSON
activities.description: Full refresh: converts Parquet to JSON. Each Parquet row becomes a JSON object.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_JSON_to_ADLS_CSV
activities.description: Full refresh: converts JSON to CSV. JSON must be tabular (array of flat objects). Nested structures are not supported by TabularTranslator without a Data Flow.

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_JSON_to_ADLS_PARQUET
activities.description: Full refresh: converts JSON to Parquet (Snappy compressed). JSON must be tabular (array of flat objects).

activities.name: Copy_ADLS_JSON_to_ADLS_JSON
activities.description: Full refresh: copies JSON to JSON. Source and target can be different storage accounts or containers.
